notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I hope you are having a great start to your week!  We're here with a small update to Cabin Fever to keep things running smoothly into the future.  In this build we:

[list]
[*] Updated the game to point to our more modern CDN for grabbing assets.
[*] Updated the typewriter effect in the game to use a more optimized method for rendering individual letters.
[/list]
Thanks for playing our games!

- Programmer Panda

notes.title: Gallery Update & More
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843345/3df3ef9fa35d5a9914a1e76d21dd68999f23a890.png[/img]

New updates for Cabin Fever! This time we've got some little fixes and improvements as requested by people in the Steam forums (thank you for taking the time to type those out!). Here's all that's new with this update:
[list]
[*] Fixed slot names in the load/save popups
[*] Fixed up some typos
[*] The Gallery now cycles through the different states of each CG (for ones that have variations)
[*] Did some minor UI polish (mostly fixing placement/layouts)
[*] Added a missing CG to the Gallery
[/list]
Thanks again to everyone who has left comments & suggestions on the Steam forums, AND all the positive reviews for our game. We really appreciate you!! You've helped polish Cabin Fever, and we're super proud of how it's turned out.

We love you so hard,
~Sad Panda
